name: Display
lead: An item, text, block or frame shown in the world, from `world.display`; its place, rotation, scale and look are live.

functions.name: animate
functions.signature: display:animate(opts: { at: Vec3 ?, scale: (Vec3 | number)?, rotation: Orientation ?, text: Text ?, color: Ink ?, background: (Ink | false)?, line_width: number ?, shadow: boolean ?, duration: number ?, })
functions.description: Makes one tweened change of place, scale, rotation or text over `duration` seconds (0.5 by default), played by the client.

functions.name: move
functions.description: Removes the display. Sets position and optional rotation together.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The raw entity id. `hit.entity` hands back this handle itself, so a pack rarely needs the number.

fields.name: billboard
fields.description: Whether it is still present. Read-only. Where it sits; live, every kind. Its yaw, pitch and roll in degrees; live. Pitch 90 lays a text flat on a table. Reads a vec3; write a number for every axis at once. How it turns toward the viewer; text defaults to "center", the other kinds to "fixed".

fields.name: glow
fields.description: Its outline colour; nil or false for none.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Seconds later changes take to play out on the client (1.19.4 and later); 0 by default.

fields.name: glide
fields.description: Advanced movement smoothing in seconds (1.20.2+); default 0.1, 0 follows duration.

fields.name: lead
fields.description: Advanced: true enables linear prediction. Default false; nil restores it. Normally submit current positions and leave this alone.

fields.name: canvas
fields.description: Item kind: the canvas shown as a filled map; written as a canvas, read back as its map id.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Item kind: how the item is posed, as in a frame, a hand or on the ground.

fields.name: text
fields.description: text kind Reads back the words; takes any text.

fields.name: color
fields.description: The colour of the words that did not pick one.

fields.name: background
fields.description: Text kind: the colour behind the words; nil or false for none.

fields.name: line_width
fields.description: Text kind: the width its lines wrap at; 200 by default.

fields.name: shadow
fields.description: Text kind: whether the words have a shadow; false by default.
